name: RoboSet: Multi-Task Real-World Robotic Manipulation Dataset
description: RoboSet is a large-scale real-world robotic manipulation dataset consisting of 28,500 trajectories collected on Franka Emika Panda arms across diverse daily kitchen activities. Developed under the RoboPen initiative at Carnegie Mellon University, RoboSet combines 9,500 teleoperated demonstration trajectories with 19,000 kinesthetic replay trajectories with scene variations. Each recorded demonstration includes synchronized 4-camera multi-view visual observations, proprioceptive joint states, and end-effector actions to evaluate imitation learning, multi-task transfer, and visual policy robustness under scene variations.
